value.rationale: This is a complete structural classification in the smallest ternary full-pair-distance MDS instance where the unrestricted population is substantially richer than the linear constructions emphasized in the literature: only 252 of 8784 maxima are affine, while 8532 are non-affine, and the 11 natural-symmetry orbits quantify that diversity. The fact is a natural benchmark for equivalence testing and for understanding nonlinear MDS symbol-pair phenomena, rather than a recomputation of the already known optimum.
